ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious File Created In PerfLogs
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious file based on their extension being created in "C:\PerfLogs\". Note that this directory mostly contains ".etl" files

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\") AND (file_path = RGX("\\\.7z$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.bat$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.bin$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.chm$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.dll$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.exe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.hta$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.lnk$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.ps1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.psm1$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.py$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.scr$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.sys$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbe$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.vbs$") OR file_path = RGX("\\\.zip$")))
